source_context.summary: Phase 4 routine Steward-governed admission trial using the validated Phase-3 streaming-performance-baseline shadow candidate unchanged.

records.statement: The accepted mobile-Web baseline measured approximately 2.2 seconds average chunk load latency with four concurrent loads.
The accepted run recorded zero failed loads, zero pending cancellations, peak residency of 36 chunks, and approximately 0.39 MiB estimated resident mesh memory.
Resource-loading throughput was the first obvious runtime scaling pressure exposed by this mobile-Web experiment.
The project should investigate where threaded resource-loading time is spent before introducing LOD to address the observed loading latency.
The internal composition of the approximately 2.2-second average mobile-Web load latency remained unresolved.
